# DevFest.cz 2026

> Prague's community developer conference: one day of talks and workshops in English on 30 October 2026 at Uhelný Mlýn, a converted coal mill in Libčice nad Vltavou, 25 minutes north of Prague. Organised by GUG.cz, z.s. since 2012.

- Date: 30 October 2026. Doors and registration 08:00, keynote 09:00, closing remarks 19:00, afterparty until 23:00 (CET).
- Venue: Uhelný Mlýn, Areál Šroubáren 860, 252 66 Libčice nad Vltavou. Map: https://maps.app.goo.gl/W5bcH4BgFQ1B8QAm8
- Audience: 350 medior and senior developers from across Central and Eastern Europe. In person only.
- Topics: AI Agents, Generative UI, Cloud & Backends, Mobile & Web, Humans in Tech.
- Contact: devfest@gug.cz
- Calendar: https://devfest.cz/2026/calendar.ics

Lists below are as of 8 November 2026; the linked pages are live.

- [Agenda](https://devfest.cz/2026/agenda): the timetable by room and time, and every talk with its abstract
